status: proposed for independent review; not lane admission
intent: Production-polished native Leptos workspace and five task modules first, connected to real owners module by module. Presentation acceptance never implies successful business execution or completed MVP.

visual_direction.theme: One complete light theme: warm amber primary accent, ink text, quiet slate canvas, white work surfaces, semantic green/amber/red states with text labels. Adapt the actual prototype rather than introducing a marketing dashboard.
visual_direction.typography: Korean-readable system/Pretendard-compatible stack; 14px minimum normal data text, 1.5 line height, clear page and section headings, tabular numbers only for numeric values. Long names wrap; IDs are secondary details, never substitute for invented names.
visual_direction.composition: Compact labeled sidebar, Company/Group context header only from authorized projection, page subject and task explanation, main workspace with list/form and real evidence/detail beside it. No fake search/avatar/counts or empty communication rail. Existing communications remain independently navigable when actually available.
visual_direction.responsive: Desktop sidebar and content; at narrow widths use native disclosure/navigation and stack evidence after subject with in-page anchors. 320px and200% zoom preserve every action and explanation. Only actual data tables may scroll horizontally.
visual_direction.interaction: Visible focus, skip-to-main, keyboard-operable native controls/disclosures, accessible labels and status announcements, no animation required. Persisted server state and local unsaved input are visually distinct. No simulated timers, success toasts or client-issued authority.

shared_contract: Navigation reflects already-authorized destinations; no role inference, no unimplemented href or disabled pretend destination. Work/People/Communications/Data/Administration grouping is available only with real authorized destinations, payroll directly discoverable.
Existing Omitted/Empty/Failure/Rows semantics stay distinct for every subresource. A successful sibling list cannot hide an authorized failure; an omitted sibling must disclose no content or failure.
All contract-shaped data attributes, current compatible routes and existing SSR/island security checks remain preserved until separately reviewed successors. No new island for static collections.

Full workflow component designs may precede adapter wiring; mount/expose only when each offered link/action is real. Test fixtures remain in tests and are never served by a product preview route or binary. Browser business data is created through real UI.
Sustained creation/correction/review uses full pages, not oversized dialogs. Evidence/annotations/discrepancies and decision consequences remain accessible beside the action.

Root owns shared styles/lib.rs composition and generated outputs. Independent module workers own separate component files after admission; Company worker alone owns native_account.*. Integration is serialized and preserves historical tests/bundle custody.

implementation_partition.shared: Shared workspace presentation and only demonstrated repeated components; explicit typed page/view models, no universal screen generator.
implementation_partition.people_employment: People directory, person subject/related employment view, typed person/employment creation/change forms and state/recovery presentation against real domain input contracts.
implementation_partition.organization_payroll_approval: Organization hierarchy/effective-change context, payroll period and preparation/review/exception context, approval evidence/consequences/decision reason; stable objects and exact owner contracts.

initial_executable_red.boundary: Existing render_screens(ShippingScreens, UiScreen), already called by mounted SSR handlers; tests use authorized viewmodel fixtures only.
requirements: Authorized people/employment and organization panels preserve distinct sibling failure states instead of silently discarding them when another list has rows.
Focused authorized page supplies one meaningful h1 and labeled primary navigation, main skip target, light-theme responsive grammar; denied content remains omitted.
Every existing schema-required data attribute and payroll island boundary remains intact; no scripted hydration for static rows.
Following implementation, browser checks layout/keyboard/320px/200% using actual mounted product and real UI-created data where records are needed. No test fixture server constitutes delivery.
initial_executable_red.admission: Exact reviewed tests must compile and fail semantically at this renderer on clean candidate. Missing imports, target/tool errors, missing Company SQL or denied native authentication are not this renderer lane's RED. Native build lease coordinated with Company owner.

acceptance: Polished presentation requires independent visual/interaction critique and prototype parity decisions; workflow acceptance additionally requires real browser authentication/current policy/owner effects/reopen/recovery. Complete five-module MVP, not a styled list or isolated component.
pre_mortem: A polished screen hides missing business behavior
Generic type abstraction replaces task-specific design
rollback: Revert reviewed presentation commit while preserving data, owner contracts, historical artifacts and tests; never restore rejected fixture routes.
stop_conditions: Fake success or unimplemented visible action
clarifications: CompanyView list is inventory, not a current scope. No current Company/Group header until explicitly selected authorized scope projection exists.
Root owns page h1. Module headings start at h2; no duplicate page subject.
Payroll SSR surrounding guide is non-run-specific; no mirror that diverges from the existing island filter.
Presentation lane does not change native_account.*, hydration source, or business action authority.
